lines.text: Iterations. AI-driven CFD, by Meteo Simulation.
lines.tts: Iterations. A.I.-driven C.F.D., by Meh-tay-oh Simulation.

lines.text: Every drone mission depends on air you cannot see.
lines.tts: Every drone mission depends on air you cannot see.
lines.ko: 보이지 않는 공기가 모든 드론 임무를 좌우합니다.

lines.text: Rotor downwash and the wake decide how it flies.
lines.tts: Rotor downwash and the wake decide how it flies.

lines.text: Describe the drone and the flight. Iterations sets up the case on its own.
lines.tts: Describe the drone and the flight. Iterations sets up the case on its own.
lines.ko:
드론과 비행 조건을 알려주면,
Iterations가 해석 케이스를 스스로 설정합니다.

lines.text: 1.3 million cells in seven minutes, with the rotors as actuator disks.
lines.tts: One point three million cells in seven minutes, with the rotors as actuator disks.
lines.ko:
7분 만에 130만 셀,
로터는 작동원판(actuator disk)으로 모델링합니다.

lines.text: Then one GPU solves the flow around the airframe and its rotors.
lines.tts: Then one G.P.U. solves the flow around the airframe and its rotors.
lines.ko: 이어서 GPU 한 장이 기체와 로터 주변의 유동을 풉니다.

lines.text: A thousand time steps in under fourteen minutes.
lines.tts: A thousand time steps in under fourteen minutes.

lines.text: Then it reviews its own result. Eight checks. The arms are under-resolved.
lines.tts: Then it reviews its own result. Eight checks. The arms are under-resolved.
lines.ko:
그리고 스스로 결과를 검토합니다.
8개 항목 점검, 암(arm) 표면 해상도 부족.

lines.text: It picks a fix, refines the mesh and runs again, automatically.
lines.tts: It picks a fix, refines the mesh and runs again, automatically.
lines.ko: 처방을 골라 격자를 세분화하고 다시 돌립니다. 자동으로.

lines.tts: Arm surface capture: twenty to fifty-nine percent.

lines.text: Every design variant can go through the same loop. Set up, solved, reviewed, improved.
lines.tts: Every design variant can go through the same loop. Set up, solved, reviewed, improved.
lines.ko:
모든 설계 변형이 같은 루프를 거칠 수 있습니다.
설정, 해석, 검토, 개선.

lines.text: Results export as USD and OpenVDB, which Isaac Sim imports.
lines.tts: Results export as U S D and Open V D B, which Isaac Sim imports.
lines.ko: 결과는 Isaac Sim이 불러오는 USD와 OpenVDB로 내보냅니다.

lines.text: So drone autonomy training environments are set up fast.
lines.tts: So drone autonomy training environments are set up fast.
lines.ko: 드론 자율비행 훈련 환경을 빠르게 구성합니다.

lines.text: And with BUL:C, Meteo Simulation's fire and evacuation simulator,
lines.tts: And with Bull-see, Meh-tay-oh Simulation's fire and evacuation simulator,

lines.text: smoke, haze and fog become physics-based training worlds.
lines.tts: smoke, haze and fog become physics-based training worlds.
lines.ko: 연기, 연무, 안개가 물리 기반 훈련 환경이 됩니다.

lines.text: Iterations. AI-driven CFD for defence and drones.
lines.tts: Iterations. A.I.-driven C.F.D. for defence and drones.
lines.ko: Iterations. 국방과 드론을 위한 AI 기반 CFD.
